data.completion_memo: Implemented deterministic canonical JSONL records, SHA-256 domain identities, bounded contiguous segments, and deny-by-default portable export scrubbing with explicit debug omissions.
data.description: Implement deterministic portable schemas and canonical byte encoding for scrubbed semantic events, segment framing, checkpoints, frozen snapshots, omission facts, and provenance. Apply the deny-by-default portability policy before serialization or hashing and reject any secret, local authority, hidden reasoning, debug capture, or executable content outside the admitted policy.
data.title: M06.1 — Implement portable semantic encoding and export policy
